name: IC Interface — I2C — DFN
description: Surface-mount I2C interface IC cluster featuring tier A parts in surface-mount DFN footprints, including DFN-10-1EP (3x3mm) and DFN-16-1EP (3x5mm) package variants.
selection_hints: Select based on required pin count and footprint size, such as DFN-10 (3x3mm) or DFN-16 (3x5mm).
Choose between LTC4316xDD and LTC4317 interface expansion parts.
Verify layout compatibility with 0.5mm pitch surface-mount DFN footprints having exposed pads.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting is required instead of surface-mount SMD.
Designs require package families other than DFN.
